New Active Ability: Tree Volley

The hero rips random trees out of the ground nearby and throws them into the specified area. Each thrown tree deals damage to enemies from the hero's attack. The ability works even if there are no trees nearby.

Area Radius: 400
Throw Interval: 0.5 sec.
Maximum Duration: 2.5 sec.
Cooldown: 12 sec.
